item.title: The Alchemist Code: Port Masters Launches in Japan With a Free UR Ouroboros and Three 10-Pull Tickets
item.description:
The Alchemist Code: Port Masters is out in Japan. K3 Studio launched the new mobile RPG on iOS and Android on November 4, 2026, and every player who logs in receives the full set of pre-registration rewards after sign-ups passed 100,000.
Port Masters is set in an alternate version of the world of The Alchemist Code (Tagatame), gumi’s tactics RPG whose original Japanese version closed in November 2024. It is free to play, with units obtained through summons.
Because the campaign reached its final milestone, the Port Masters launch comes with every reward unlocked:
Battles are played in portrait mode and built for speed. A team is made of five main units and two tactical units, and the result depends on how gear, tactics, buffs, debuffs and skill order are combined before the fight starts. Many skills from the original game return, along with special skill cut-ins.
The main multiplayer mode is the Port Battle, a real-time fight for up to 10 players where ports compete with each other using shared Force Skills.
The launch trailer is narrated by Natsuki Hanae, who voiced Logi in the original game, and Inori Minase, who played Kasumi in the animated film. It marks the 10th anniversary of The Alchemist Code and the 7th of the movie.
On X, the official account is running a giveaway until November 15, a character quiz until November 22 and a popularity vote from November 4 to 10. The game is available on the Japanese App Store and Google Play; there is no word on a release outside Japan. The full announcement is on the official press release, and our pre-registration coverage has the earlier details.

item.title: NIKKE Says Its PC Launcher Script Files May Have Been Tampered With by a Third Party
item.description:
The notice went out on the game’s official X accounts in English and Japanese. SHIFT UP develops NIKKE and Level Infinite publishes it worldwide on PC, iOS and Android.
According to the statement, the team identified an issue indicating that files used by the PC launcher may have been altered by someone outside the company. Client fixes and an update were rolled out at around 02:30 (UTC+9) on November 4.
The team says it is still investigating the scope of the impact and will publish details of any follow-up measures in a separate notice. The message ends with an apology for the inconvenience.
【Notice Regarding PC Launcher Anomaly】 We have identified an issue indicating that the PC Launcher’s script files may have been tampered with by a third party.
— GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE (@NIKKE_en) November 4, 2026
The notice does not say how the files were changed, how long they were exposed, what the altered scripts could do, or how many players launched the game during that window. It also refers only to the PC launcher: the iOS and Android versions are not mentioned.
Replies under the official post show players asking whether they need to reinstall their system or change passwords. The NIKKE team has not answered those questions publicly, and the follow-up notice it promised is where that information would be expected to appear.
The incident lands in the middle of the game’s 4th anniversary, with the MARIA-n story event running and the Scarlet: Goddeath pick-up recruitment scheduled for November 5 at 05:00 (UTC+9).

item.title: Petit Planet Is Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027 After Passing 10 Million Pre-Registrations
item.description:
HoYoverse has confirmed that Petit Planet is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027. The announcement came on November 1 on the game’s official X account, the same day the cozy life sim passed 10 million global pre-registrations, a month before its launch on mobile and PC.
The console version arrives later: the game still opens worldwide on December 4 on iOS, Android, PC and the Epic Games Store, with pre-download from December 1. The studio says it is working on the Switch 2 build and will share gameplay footage and more details soon.
On November 3 the press got to play the console version for the first time. The official photos from the session show the demo running in handheld mode: a Planet Tender reeling in a fish on the open sea, and another walking up to their house with the action wheel open. The control cards on each table map the tools to the triggers, with ZL to switch tools, ZR to use them, R to jump and X to open the backpack.
The full special program, with the development team and a guest walking through daily life on the planet, is on the game’s official channel:
In Petit Planet the player becomes a Planet Tender who looks after a small planet of their own: farming, fishing, cooking, crafting and exploring the Starsea, while decorating the house and befriending the Neighbors who live there. It is HoYoverse’s first life sim.

item.title: Trickcal Patima Shows Its First Gameplay, With Closed Beta Sign-Ups in Early 2027
item.description:
EPID Games, the studio behind Trickcal Re:VIVE, has released the first gameplay of Trickcal Patima, its next game. The Alpha Build Teaser PV came out on November 2, 2026, and the studio plans to open sign-ups for the first closed beta in Q1 2027.
Trickcal Patima, also written as Trickcal Fatima in some English coverage, was first revealed on June 29 with a teaser site. It keeps the squishy-cheeked characters of the first game, now in a near-future city with a slice-of-life tone. EPID Games is also looking for a publisher to run the global service, so it can focus on development.
The game starts the same way as Trickcal Re:VIVE: by pulling a character’s cheek on the title screen. From there it moves to an animated lobby where the cast walks around the city, with a Recruit menu for drawing characters and a progression menu called WorkNet.
Characters keep the personality-based attributes of the first game, such as Gloomy and Lively, and gear progression is built around relics, set items you farm and enhance. The main content sits under Departure, split into Cuberinth, Exploration and Full Ownership Tour. Combat is turn-based with a party of four, where turn order depends on speed and action gauges, and the camera swings behind each character before a skill. The teaser ends with a boss battle and a short scene of the studio’s heads arguing over whose job it is to find a publisher.
There is no release date yet. The next step is the Trickcal Patima closed beta, with tester recruitment planned for the first quarter of 2027. Details will be posted on the official teaser site.
Platforms and regions have not been announced either, and they will depend on which publisher takes the game.

item.title: Silver Palace Launches Globally on December 14 on PC, PS5, iOS and Android
item.description:
Silver Palace launches globally on December 14, 2026 (UTC+8) on Android, iOS, PC and PlayStation 5. Elementa announced the date on October 31, and the open-world detective action RPG has now passed 15 million global pre-registrations.
Pre-registration is open on the official website, the App Store and Google Play, and the game is also listed on the Epic Games Store and PlayStation Store. The milestone campaign is still running: depending on pre-registrations and social media followers, players unlock rewards that include a brand-new 4-star character and 20 Simulation Shots.
Silver Palace is set in Silvernia, a metropolis inspired by Victorian aesthetics and powered by a mysterious substance called Silverium. Industry is advancing fast, rival factions are fighting over the resource, and the city hides a web of conspiracies under its glittering surface. The player is a detective who investigates cases, follows clues and works alongside a cast of companions to uncover what is really happening.
The game runs on Unreal Engine 5 with an anime art style and free exploration of the city’s districts. Combat is real-time, with character switching and skill synergies between party members.
The launch date arrived together with The Foolish and the Brave, the character trailer for Gratia. It is a short look at the character before launch.
Silver Palace will support 12 languages at launch: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, Thai, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese and Russian. Before the Silver Palace release date, Elementa will also take the game to gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show 2026 and South Korea’s Anime X Game Festival 2026, after earlier stops at Anime Expo, Japan Expo and gamescom.
Elementa has not announced a launch time or a pre-download date yet.

item.title: Petit Planet Launches Globally on December 4, With Pre-Download Starting December 1
item.description:
HoYoverse has set the date for the Petit Planet global launch: the cozy life sim opens worldwide on December 4 on iOS, Android and PC, with pre-download starting on December 1.
The date arrived on October 30 with a new trailer on the game’s official channel, closing the “Winter 2026” window the studio had given at gamescom. Pre-registration is still open and comes with exclusive rewards for everyone who signs up before launch.
On PC, Petit Planet will be available through its own Windows client and the Epic Games Store; on mobile, through the App Store and Google Play. Pre-download opens three days early, on December 1, so the game can be installed before the servers go live.
The release date trailer follows a single day on a small planet: a Planet Tender plans a picnic with the Neighbors, picks an outfit, gathers ingredients, cooks a spread of dishes and ends the night around a cake by candlelight, with fireworks over the trees.
In Petit Planet the player becomes a Planet Tender who looks after a planet of their own and watches it grow. The day-to-day loop is farming, fishing, crafting, cooking and exploring the Starsea, while decorating the house and dressing up the character with outfits and accessories.
The planet is shared with the Neighbors, animal and human residents who chat with the player and invite them to gatherings like the picnic, and the game also supports multiplayer. It is HoYoverse’s first life sim, after a final test that ran from September 20.

item.title: IDOLY PRIDE Will End Service in Japan on March 1, 2027, and Become an Offline Game
item.description:
QualiArts has announced the IDOLY PRIDE end of service: the Japanese version of the idol management RPG will shut down on March 1, 2027, and the game will then be updated into an offline version.
The notice went out on the game’s official X account on October 30, 2026. IDOLY PRIDE launched on iOS and Android on June 24, 2021, so the service will close after roughly five years and nine months.
The game stays fully playable until the shutdown, and QualiArts says livestreams and in-game events will keep running during the remaining months. The full schedule of what ends and when is published in the in-game notices.
Players with unused paid currency should keep an eye on the same notices: the application process for a refund of paid Blue Diamonds is explained there.
Instead of disappearing completely, IDOLY PRIDE will receive an update that turns it into an offline version. QualiArts has not yet detailed what that version will keep, so it is not known which story chapters, idols or songs will remain available once the servers go dark.
In the game, the player takes on the role of a manager who forms idol units, clears live performances and guides their idols to the top of the VENUS Program ranking, one of the pieces of the wider IDOLY PRIDE multimedia project.

item.title: Honkai: Star Rail 4.7 Arrives November 11 With Aeon Aha and a Free Limited 5-Star
item.description:
The version also hands every player one limited 5-star of their choice for free — Acheron, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae or Jing Yuan — and introduces a new growth system called Affinitive Eidolon.
For over a thousand Amber Eras, the leviathan known as the Voracity has been kept sealed by Aha’s Phantasmoon Games. Now it is about to wake up, so the Aeon of Elation summons eight Supplicants for the Final Phantasmoon Games and sets sail on the Starfroster, a cake-like ship meant to lure the beast in, with the Trailblazer at their side.
In combat, Aeon ★ Aha is a limited 5-star on the Path of Elation who makes the Path itself ascend, giving every Elation character a unique new ability. Aha also stars in the new Aha Instant, which fast-forwards Elation Skills. The whole team builds up Wishpower during battle, and once it is full Aha’s Ultimate deals Elation damage to all enemies; with their Aeonic Authority, ally attacks can even reduce enemies’ Max HP. The version trailer follows Aha and the Trailblazer into that last performance.
Aeon ★ Aha debuts with Version 4.7. The first half reruns Silver Wolf LV.999, Sparxie and Yao Guang, while the second half brings back Acheron, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae and Jing Yuan, alongside their signature Light Cones Along the Passing Shore, Brighter Than the Sun and Before Dawn.
Those three second-half characters are also the first to get an Affinitive Eidolon: once you own the character and unlock it, they gain new abilities, new animations and character-themed combat buffs. During Version 4.7, logging in lets you pick one Affinitive Eidolon for Acheron, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae or Jing Yuan.
The main event is The Fluffy Movie: Overheated, where the Trailblazer helps Aha run a dessert shop to earn Gold Coins, and the combat event Interastral Peace Gala: Road to Fame runs at the same time. The Trailblazer Mission also rewards the new 4-star Elation Light Cone See You at the World’s End!
The permanent mode Currency Wars starts its second season, Voyage Into the Canvas, with a full overhaul. Taking part in Phantasia Showstage gives a chance at Aha’s limited outfit Star Lotto, and every reward left in the pool is granted for free once you get it. The animated short A Joyful Funeral Beneath the Moon releases on launch day, and the new track Ex Nihilo accompanies Aha’s final performance.
The three codes from the Version 4.7 Special Program — NEVERGONNAGIVE, NEVERGONNAMAKE and AHABLESSYOU — only work until October 31 at 23:59 (UTC+8), so they have to be redeemed before the update arrives.

item.title: KOF: Legend Launches November 4 in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Southeast Asia, Pre-Registration Open
item.description:
KOF: Legend, an idle card RPG licensed by SNK, launches on November 4, 2026 in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau and Southeast Asia. Pre-registration is open now on the App Store and Google Play. The KOF: Legend release date was announced on October 27 by JOYMAKER GAMES, together with the first gameplay trailer.
It is a different game from Netmarble’s The King of Fighters AFK. KOF: Legend uses 3D models instead of pixel art, and puts the player in the role of a manager who recruits, trains and upgrades fighters from the series.
Every fighter belongs to a faction, and the factions counter each other like rock, paper, scissors: reading the enemy lineup and sending in the fighter who beats it is the core of each battle. Up to three fighters fight on the field at once in real time, and lining up fighters from the same faction activates bonuses. Ultimate cards, chips, the Three Sacred Treasures and equipment complete each build. There are no combos to input: the game is built to be picked up in seconds.
The first five fighters revealed are Kyo Kusanagi (Paper, melee damage), Mai Shiranui (Paper, ranged damage), Iori Yagami (Rock, melee damage), Athena Asamiya (Paper, ranged healer) and Orochi (Rock, ranged damage). Their signature moves are recreated in 3D, from Kyo’s 100 Shiki: Oni Yaki to Iori’s Ya Otome, with the series’ classic music.
The story mode retells the Orochi, NESTS and Ash sagas, and the classic bosses can be recruited for the team: Orochi, Rugal, Clone Zero and Magaki. Players can also team up with two friends against bosses in real time, join a club and take part in 50 vs 50 guild battles.
The gameplay trailer shows the 3D fights and the special moves:
Pre-registration milestones unlock training manuals, diamonds and an Epic fighter chest, all claimed at launch. Inviting friends to form a squad through a personal pre-registration link also unlocks an exclusive manager outfit.
